attributes.name: Aravashnial
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add 1d6 plus the scenario's adventure deck number to any Intelligence, Arcane, or Knowledge check by a character at your location.

Bury this card to add a random spell from your discard pile to your hand.; if you do this on your turn, and if you have a role card, you may explore your location.
